## Open Questions
- TO CONFIRM: Story 1.2 auth details — exact login route (e.g. `POST /api/users/login`), credential transport (JWT `Authorization: Token <jwt>` header vs session cookie), and token expiry. Needed by every authenticated case. — Owner: dev (Story 1.2) / BA.
- TO CONFIRM: exact status code + body for a missing/invalid credential (401 vs 403). Conduit convention is 401. — Owner: dev.
- TO CONFIRM: not-found status/body for an unknown profile or follow target (404 vs 422 `{ "errors": {...} }`). — Owner: dev / BA.
- TO CONFIRM: status/body for invalid or malformed update payloads (400 vs 422). — Owner: dev / BA.
- TO CONFIRM: whether self-follow, duplicate follow, and unfollow-when-not-following are idempotent (200) or rejected (4xx) — behaviour not fixed by the AC. — Owner: BA.
- TO CONFIRM: expected `following` value when viewing your own profile (Conduit convention: false). — Owner: BA.
- TO CONFIRM: whether the API sanitizes/escapes `bio` on write or defers escaping to the UI layer (TC-SEC-06). — Owner: dev.
- TO CONFIRM: status returned by the Next.js Route Handlers for an unsupported HTTP verb (404 vs 405) — TC-SEC-07. — Owner: dev.
- TO CONFIRM (AC-5): the legacy Conduit backend base URL/port (assumed `http://localhost:3001`), that it is running, and that its seed data (alice/bob, follow state) mirrors the new instance so the parity comparison is apples-to-apples. — Owner: ve / dev.
- TO CONFIRM: whether an app-process restart is practical in the local setup for the persistence check in TC-INT-02 step 3. — Owner: ve.
